direct_evidence_seeds.title: Oblivion Crisis linked game evidence
direct_evidence_seeds.notes: Follow references into Oblivion quests, dialogue, books, gates and related game pages rather than relying on summary alone.

direct_evidence_seeds.title: Oblivion Lore book collection
direct_evidence_seeds.notes: UESP identifies a reprint collection containing On Oblivion, On the Nature of Coldharbour, Spirit of the Daedra, Book of Daedra, Doors of Oblivion, Slave Pits of Coldharbour and Varieties of Daedra.

review_focus: Dragon Break/Warp in the West material must preserve source-specific accounts
Talos/Tiber Septim identity and apotheosis claims require source attribution
Mythic Dawn doctrine is evidence of the cult's doctrine, not automatic objective cosmology
separate direct Oblivion Crisis quest/event evidence from later historical summaries
do not merge Akaviri cultural groups merely because summaries use the broad Akaviri label
